method: Both locales authored directly from canonical Japanese. Full own-pair semantic self-review of every unit; no other-pair reads, peer review or external translation service.
coverage: All titles, full explanatory and example paragraphs, application prompts, key terms and both illustration alt texts.
semanticChecks: Finished versus developed dimensions, datum edges, template revision and cut/bend/join marking purposes remain separate.
Tool/material capacity, retained side, line width, edge burrs, dimension records and later handling conditions are not conflated.
Bend support, front/back direction, bend allowance and springback retain source limits; no striking procedure added.
Fusion welding does not always require filler; clamps, tack welds, full joint completion and inspection are separate.
Heat deformation and pre/post measurement time are retained; qualification does not certify every joint.
Rectangular duct shape does not specify flange type; angle frame/body and mating ends are separately checked.
Bolt fastening differs from sealing and airtightness testing; smoke-exhaust suitability is not inferred from name.
Integral-edge and slide-on flanges, corner/edge parts, spot welding and reinforcement retain specification-dependent scope.
Round duct diameter and spiral manufacture do not prescribe fittings; overlaps, sheet-metal screws and tape have distinct roles.
No invented fastener counts, size boundaries, universal performance ranking or complete-system guarantee.
